title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.79
summary: Dynamische Kamera-Startkapazität nach verfügbaren CPU-/RAM-Ressourcen sowie sichere Wiederverwendung bewährter Kameraprofile.
changes: Adapt the camera startup concurrency to available CPU and Docker container RAM
Keep the existing baseline when resource data is unavailable or the host is busy
Persist only the last successful ONVIF profile and transport per camera across reboot
Preserve the queue prioritization and all existing recording/streaming safety guards
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.79
description: Dynamically adjust camera connection admission using host/cgroup pressure and persist the last verified ONVIF profile per camera.
releaseNotes: 2.20.79 scales camera startup admission from the existing safe baseline toward available CPU and memory capacity without exceeding container cgroup limits. Each camera reuses its last successfully verified ONVIF profile/transport across backend restarts; no passwords or RTSP addresses are persisted, and normal fallback remains available. All recording, camera and kiosk settings remain intact.
